title: Career and Professional Development I
description: This course is designed to introduce students to foundational concepts in career and professional development equipping them with essential knowledge, skills, and strategies for navigating their careers and achieving professional growth. Students will engage with topics such as career exploration, resumes, interview strategies, networking, and career preparation. Practical application is emphasized through assignments integrating self-assessment and reflection, industry research, experiential learning, and professional skill development.
prerequisites: Open to majors in the Martin-Gatton College of Agriculture, Food and Environment
